title: Require the DAO validator to read the same replay store it commits
description: P1 security: DaoManager.__post_init__ enforces replay_store identity only when origin_validator.replay_store is non-None. A validator with replay_store=None plus a real persistence backend (even require_crash_safety=True) validates every repeated DAO as fresh; the manager writes floors that the validator never reads, so equal/lower replays can be accepted and refresh/mutate routes. When origin validation is configured, require a non-None replay store identical to persistence and verify its crash-safe/fail-closed capabilities in production; add equal/lower replay tests for the current None configuration.
